topic.title: Storage
topic.shortdesc: Where uploads, post media, video renders, footage and attachments are kept: on the server's disk, or in Google Drive once it is connected.

body.p: To store new files in Google Drive, connect a Google account and choose Drive under File storage in Accounts.

The meter shows how full the server's disk is; uploads stop with Storage is full before the last few hundred MB. Video renders older than the retention period are deleted each night unless an approval still needs them. With Drive, its usage and Open the folder are shown too. By folder breaks it down.
The newest 500 files, filterable by folder. Preview, Open or Delete each one.
body.note: Deleting can't be undone, and anything that links to the file, such as a post or an approval, loses it.
